metrics.method: Full history: 775 non-service messages, 2025-08-25 to 2026-09-17, 313 from the client. client_questions_total = the 59 client messages containing an explicit '?' plus 12 direct non-question asks that plainly required a response (account-warning screenshots, '.vip restricted my accounts', 'let me know if you recieved it', the two emoticon requests). unanswered_over_24h = of those 71, the ones that never received a substantive on-topic answer within 24h, hand-classified by reading each thread — a bare @tag, an emoji, or a 'let me check' that was never followed up counts as unanswered. A naive 'any team message within 24h' test returns 0 because this chat is never quiet, which is exactly why it has to be read rather than counted. max_team_silence_days = 11 (2025-12-03 -> 2025-12-15) counting only non-templated human outbound; it is 9 days (2026-03-06 -> 2026-03-15) if automated DMCA/leak recaps and reel-inspo link dumps are counted as contact. promises_* = hand-enumerated distinct forward-looking commitments by ALTR staff and vendors (a regex sweep for commitment language surfaces 35 messages; reading the threads brings the true count to ~68 because many commitments are implicit in the reply). Kept = delivered or visibly actioned; lapsed = never delivered and never withdrawn.
